reasoning_content: The token test failed because the client is confidential (needs client_secret). Let me test with the secret.

action.command: cd /workspace && SECRET=$(grep '^LOCAL_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET=' .env | cut -d= -f2); echo "=== token with client secret ==="; curl -s -m 15 -X POST "http://localhost:9090/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=local-client&client_secret=$SECRET&username=spark@example.com&password=SparkLocal123!" 2>&1 | head -c 200; echo; echo "=== search attr ProjectId ==="; docker exec workspace-temporal-init-1 temporal operator search-attribute list --address temporal:7233 --namespace default 2>&1 | grep -i project
